name: Record
tagline: A sourced, permanent record of documented harm in armed conflict and the response to it.
scope: Findings, investigations, court actions, sanctions, arms and aid transfers, and official data about civilian harm in a named conflict. Uses the evidence tiers in METHOD.md. Excludes graphic imagery and unverified viral claims.
major: a UN or court finding; an indictment, warrant or judgment; a sanctions action; a new official casualty or displacement dataset; a major arms or aid decision
watch: ICC/ICJ dockets; UN OCHA and OHCHR releases; Treasury OFAC actions; congressional notifications
search_queries: ICC OR ICJ ruling OR warrant
